blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Scene rearrangement is an essential task for 3D content creation applications, requiring generation of diverse, aesthetic and functional scene rearrangements. We present SceneDesigner3D, an agentic evolutionary search method for 3D indoor scene rearrangement that systematically explores the design space of 3D scenes and generates multiple solutions according to common interior design principles. Given an input scene and a text prompt, SceneDesigner3D represents the rearrangement as an editable program and evolves a population of candidate layouts. Starting from distinct design ideas, a VLM agent mutates the programs by refining promising candidates, exploring new rearrangement strategies or redesigning from scratch, while verifying the layouts for physical validity. Proposals are scored by a VLM judge for adherence to the input prompt and satisfaction of design principles such as balance, zoning and emphasis, as well as numerically computed principles such as circulation and clutter. An archive of top-performing, structurally varied candidates further increases diversity of rearrangements. Experiments on the SAGE-10k and SceneSmith datasets show that SceneDesigner3D improves prompt adherence and computed design principle scores over baselines by up to 5.1% and 15.2%, respectively. Code will be made publicly available.
blocks.zh: 场景重排是3D内容创建应用程序的一项基本任务,需要生成多样性,美学和功能性的场景重排. 我们介绍SceneDesigner3D,是一种用于3D室内场景重排的代理演化搜索方法,它系统地探索了3D场景的设计空间,并根据共同的内部设计原理生成多款解决方案. 考虑到一个输入场景和一个文本提示,SceneDesigner3D作为可编辑的程序代表了重排,并演化出一组候选布局. 从不同的设计理念开始,一个VLM代理通过精炼有前途的候选者,探索新的重排策略或从零开始重新设计来改变程序,同时验证物理有效性的布局. 提议由一位VLM法官评分,以确定是否遵守了平衡、分区和强调等设计原则以及流通和杂乱无章等数字计算原则的迅速投入和满意程度。 一批业绩最佳、结构多样的候选人进一步增加了重新安排的多样性。 对SAGE-10k和SceneSmith数据集的实验显示,SceneDesigner3D可以提高快速的遵守率并计算出设计原则在基线上的得分,分别最高可达5.1%和15.2%. 守则将公布于众。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D indoor scene rearrangement is a central task for content creation applications such as interior design, games and movies, as well as embodied AI systems that need to plan and interact with the world around them. Given an input 3D indoor scene, the task is to rearrange the objects in the scene following the input prompt while keeping the scene physically plausible and functional without collisions or unusable objects. This task is challenging for several reasons: the solution space is combinatorial over tens to hundreds of input objects, and moving one object can affect the functionality and aesthetics of the scene both locally and globally. Moreover, the prompt, functionality and aesthetics often compete with each other and must be traded off. There are typically many desirable solutions, and committing to a single solution can miss better ones. Generating a diverse set of high-quality solutions can enable users and interior designers to choose the one that best fits their needs.
blocks.zh: 3D室内场景重排是室内设计,游戏和电影等内容创建应用的核心任务,以及包含的AI系统,需要与周围的世界进行规划和互动. 考虑到一个输入3D室内场景,任务是在输入提示后对场景中的物体进行重新排列,同时保持场景的物理上合理,功能上没有碰撞或无法使用的物品. 这项任务具有挑战性,原因有以下几个: 溶液空间为数十到数百个输入对象的组合空间,移动一个物体可以影响场景的功能和美学,无论是局部还是全球. 此外,迅速、功能和美学往往相互竞争,必须加以交换。 通常有许多可取的解决办法,而致力于单一的解决办法可能会错过更好的解决办法。 生成一套多样的高质量解决方案,可以使用户和内部设计师选择最适合其需要的解决方案.

blocks.en: Previous work has shown notable results on the rearrangement task by leveraging the strong semantic priors present in LLMs (large language models) and VLMs (vision-language models) to generate hierarchical scene edits [ 8 ] , generate code with optimizable constraints [ 25 ] or other structured formats [ 9 ] . They produce plausible rearrangements but optimize, at most, local constraints (“next to”, “facing”). However, functionally usable and aesthetic scenes require global principles such as clear walking paths, reachability, division of space into zones and visual balance among objects [ 6 , 17 ] . These principles depend on the overall layout and cannot be captured by local constraints. Further, existing methods are designed to generate a single rearranged layout following the input text prompt, and do not systematically search the space of possible solutions to optimize for such principles.
blocks.zh: 以往的工作通过利用LLMs(大语言模型)和VLMs(视觉语言模型)中存在的强烈语义前传,生成分级场景编辑[8],生成有可选择限制的代码[25]或其他结构格式[9],在重排任务上取得了显著成果. 它们产生合理的重新安排,但最多可以优化当地的限制(“下一步”,“改进”)。 然而,功能可用和美学场景需要全球原则,如清晰的步行路径、可到达性、空间划分为区以及物体之间的视觉平衡[6、17]。 这些原则取决于总体布局,不能被地方制约所抓住. 此外,现有方法的设计是为了在输入文本提示后产生单一的重排版式,而不系统地搜索可能的解决方案空间以优化这些原则。

blocks.en: In contrast, we propose an evolutionary approach to scene rearrangement in order to achieve both adherence to the input text prompt as well as satisfaction of common interior design principles. Evolving a diverse set of rearrangement proposals based on different high-level functional and aesthetic design seeds allows us to search the interior design space systematically and move towards more functional and aesthetically pleasing scene arrangements. Evolutionary methods have shown considerable progress in solving mathematical and programming tasks [ 20 , 13 , 22 ] , but their application to scene-level 3D generation and editing tasks remains limited [ 11 , 24 ] .
blocks.zh: 与此相反,我们提议采用循序渐进的方法进行重新排列,以便既能遵守即时输入文本,又能满足共同的内部设计原则。 在不同的高层次功能和美学设计种子的基础上,逐步形成一套多样的重排方案,使我们能够系统地搜索室内设计空间,并朝着更实用和更美学地取悦场景安排的方向发展。 演化方法在解决数学和编程任务[20,13,22]方面显示出相当大的进展,但它们在场景级3D生成和编辑任务的应用仍然有限[11,24].

blocks.en:
To generate such functional and aesthetic scenes, we propose SceneDesigner3D, an evolutionary search method built on top of frontier VLMs that iteratively mutates and evaluates rearrangements of an input scene. The rearrangement is represented as a mutable program that takes the original scene as input and moves its objects. The program is updated by a VLM mutator agent that can propose and validate programs before sending them to a VLM judge for evaluation. The mutator only edits programs, and the evolutionary search maintains a population of valid layouts and selects promising candidates to mutate further. We decompose the input prompt into a few verifiable
requirements, and use ten abstract design principles from the interior
design literature, such as zoning, balance and emphasis [ 17 , 6 ] . Each proposal is rendered from multiple viewpoints, and a VLM judge compares it to its parent on every requirement and principle. It returns relative preferences, absolute scores, and concrete reasoning grounded in the layout as feedback to the mutator. Principles that can be measured geometrically, such as circulation, focal point and clutter, are computed numerically from the layout. The computed scores give the mutator precise feedback across iterations, and together with the judge scores they determine the fitness.
blocks.zh:
为了产生这样的功能性和审美场景,我们提出SceneDesigner3D,一种基于前沿VLM之上的进化搜索方法,它迭代变异并评价一个输入场景的重排. 重排表示为可变程序,将原场景作为输入,移动其对象. 程序由一个VLM变异器代理更新,在发送到VLM法官进行评估前,可以提出和验证程序. 变异者只编辑程序,进化搜索保持了一组有效的布局,并选择有希望的候选人进一步变异. 我们把输入分解成几个可核查的
使用内部十项抽象设计原则

blocks.en: We design several mechanisms to grow a diverse set of candidate rearrangements, such as proposing various initial design seeds for the layouts and refining them across islands, and an archive [ 18 ] of high-quality layouts that serve as inspiration for new proposals. Additionally, we enable the VLM mutator to choose from different mutation strategies: exploring initial design seeds, localized edits to refine existing proposals, and generation of large mutations to explore rearrangements dissimilar to the parent proposal.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了几种机制,以培育一套多样的候选重排方案,例如为各种布局提出各种初步设计种子,并在各岛屿上加以精炼,以及一个高质量布局的档案[18],为新的提案提供灵感。 此外,我们让VLM变异器从不同的变异策略中选择:探索初始设计种子,本地化编辑以完善现有提案,生成大型变异器以探索不同于母提案的重排.

blocks.en: We evaluate SceneDesigner3D and several state-of-the-art scene editing and generation baselines on two agentically generated synthetic indoor scene datasets: SAGE-10k [ 32 ] and SceneSmith [ 21 ] , as well as an improved version of SAGE-10k generated using Claude Opus 5.5. Our method improves upon the baselines in all settings in terms of prompt adherence, design principle scores and diversity.
blocks.zh: 我们评价SceneDesigner3D和两个代理生成的合成室内场景数据集上的一些最新场景编辑和生成基线:SAGE-10k [32]和SceneSmith [21],以及使用Claude Opus 5.5生成的SAGE-10k的改进版. 我们的方法在迅速遵守、设计原则分数和多样性方面改进了所有情况下的基线。

blocks.en: To summarize, our contributions are: • an agentic evolutionary search method for 3D scene rearrangement that represents the rearrangement as an editable program, and mutates the programs with a VLM agent that drafts and validates candidates • an evaluator that verifies commonly used design principles, consisting of a VLM judge that assesses abstract design principles such as balance and emphasis, along with geometric computation of measurable principles such as circulation and clutter • diversity mechanisms that generate structurally different rearrangements, including multiple high-level seed ideas, a mutator that can switch between seed exploration, large rearrangements and fine-grained refinements, and an archive of high-quality layouts capturing varied anchor-object placements
blocks.zh: 概括地说,我们的贡献是: 3D场景重排的代理演化搜索方法,将重排作为可编辑程序,并用一个起草和验证候选人的VLM代理器对程序进行变异; 由一位核查常用设计原则的评价员组成,该评价员负责评估平衡和强调等抽象设计原则,同时对可计量原则进行几何计算,如循环和杂交等 多样性机制,产生结构上不同的重排,包括多个高层次种子想法,可以在种子探索、大规模重排和精细精细精细改进之间切换的变异器,以及一个记录各种锚标布局的高质量布局档案

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 LLM-based 3D Scene Generation and Editing
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于 LLM 的三维场景生成和编辑

blocks.en: Previous methods such as ScanEdit [ 8 ] and HOG-Layout [ 10 ] use LLMs for planning primarily local scene edits hierarchically or in groups. Edit-As-Act [ 19 ] uses goal-regressive planning to plan local edits. LayoutVLM [ 25 ] uses a VLM for generating a programmatic representation of a scene along with optimization constraints. LayoutGPT [ 9 ] and HDSL [ 15 ] use LLMs to generate or edit the scene in structured formats. EditRoom [ 34 ] performs a limited set of edits through scene graph diffusion. SceneAssistant [ 16 ] uses an agentic refinement loop for physically validated scene generation. These methods do not optimize for overall functionality and aesthetics of the generated layouts. In contrast, we use an agentic evolutionary search that proposes diverse layout candidates using an LLM and VLM while explicitly optimizing for diversity and design principles.
blocks.zh: 先前的方法如ScanEdit [8] 和HOG-Layout [10] 使用LLMs进行规划,主要进行局部场景的分级或分组编辑. Edit-As-Act [19] 使用目标递减规划来规划本地编辑. 布局VLM [25] 使用VLM来生成一个场景的方案表现以及优化限制. 布局GPT [9] 和 HDSL [15] 使用 LLMs 以结构化格式生成或编辑场景. 编辑室 [34] 通过场景图传播来进行一组有限的编辑. 场景助理 [16] 使用代理精细循环进行物理验证的场景生成. 这些方法对于生成的布局的整体功能和美学并不优化. 相比之下,我们使用一种代理进化搜索方法,采用LLM和VLM提出不同的布局选择,同时明确优化多样性和设计原则。

blocks.en: 2.2 Agentic Evolutionary Methods
blocks.zh: 2.2 代理演化方法

blocks.en: ShinkaEvolve [ 13 ] adapts standard evolutionary methods for sample efficiency using LLM agents, based on AlphaEvolve which generates thousands of proposals [ 20 ] . Similarly, ThetaEvolve [ 30 ] and FrugalEvo [ 5 ] reduce the cost of the evolution search through cheaper LLMs or make use of larger program databases. These methods have primarily been used for programming and algorithmic tasks, and their application to 3D indoor scenes is limited. We base our method on ShinkaEvolve, and add diversity mechanisms, agentic mutation and VLM evaluation of design principles for the task of 3D scene rearrangement.
blocks.zh: ShinkaEvolve [13] 调整使用LLM剂进行样本效率的标准演化方法,基于生成数千个建议书的AlphaEvolve [20]. 同样,ThetaEvolve [30]和FrugalEvo [5]通过更便宜的LLMs或利用更大的程序数据库来降低进化搜索的成本. 这些方法主要用于编程和算法任务,它们对3D室内场景的应用有限. 我们的方法基于ShinkaEvolve, 并添加多样性机制, 代理突变和VLM 评估 设计原理的任务 3D场景重排。

blocks.en: 2.3 Evolution and Principled 3D Scene Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 演化与原则性三维场景生成

blocks.en:
Previous methods have optimized layouts for design principles with evolutionary algorithms [ 11 , 2 ] or greedy cost minimization [ 12 ] . SceneMosaic [ 24 ] generates a set of scene rearrangements with limited diversity by performing an agentic refinement loop on the input scene, while we perform a full evolutionary search that systematically explores the interior design space.
LayoutEnhancer [ 14 ] uses an ergonomic loss that optimizes for limited design principles on top of a generative model, but does not search through the design space.
Make it Home [ 33 ] infers object relationships from example scenes, and optimizes for a fixed set of design principles such as accessibility and visibility. Unlike these methods, SceneDesigner3D conditions on text prompts, is readily extensible to new design principles and does not need hand-tuned differentiable cost functions.
blocks.zh:
之前的方法已经优化了以演化算法[11,2]或贪婪成本最小化[12]的设计原理的布局. SceneMosaic [24]通过在输入场景上进行代理式的完善循环,生成一组具有有限多样性的场景重排,同时我们进行一个完整的进化搜索,系统地探索内部设计空间.
布局 Enhancer [14] 使用一种基因组损失,在基因模型之上优化有限设计原理,但不通过设计空间搜索.
Make it Home [33] 从实例场景推断出对象关系,并优化了无障碍性和能见度等固定设计原则. 与这些方法不同的是,SceneDesigner3D在文本提示上的条件,很容易延伸至新的设计原理,不需要手调不同的成本功能.

blocks.en: 2.4 Scene Rearrangement Planning
blocks.zh: 2.4 场景重新安排 规划

blocks.en:
Rearrangement planning methods such as
SceneMover [ 28 ] , ESRP [ 4 ] , PEARL [ 29 ] , PLATO [ 31 ] and HAISOR [ 26 ] take the start and end states of the scene as input, and optimize with reinforcement learning for shortest paths. In contrast, we show an extension of SceneDesigner3D that jointly plans moves during evolution.
blocks.zh:
重新安排规划方法,例如:
场景Mover [28],ESRP [4],PEARL [29],PLATO [31]和HAISOR [26] 以场景的始末状态作为投入,并优化与强化学习,用于最短的路径. 相比之下,我们展示了SceneDesigner3D的扩展,它共同计划了进化过程中的移动.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Method overview. Given an input 3D scene and a text prompt, SceneDesigner3D evolves a population of programs that rearrange its objects. The prompt is decomposed into requirements, design seeds are initialized and objects are described by a VLM. An agentic evolutionary search explores the design space through various strategies (colored paths: object movement relative to parent). Each candidate is judged by a VLM against its parent on the prompt requirements and design principles, and combined with numerically computed principles into its fitness. An archive keeps diverse candidates as inspiration for future iterations, giving diverse layouts that follow the prompt and design principles.

blocks.en: We formulate rearrangement as an evolutionary search over programs that edit the scene ( Fig. 2 ). SceneDesigner3D evolves a population of such programs by repeating parent selection, mutation and evaluation steps. In each iteration, SceneDesigner3D selects a parent to mutate and a mutation strategy from a fixed set of strategies, and produces a new candidate layout through an agentic session. The layout is then evaluated by a VLM for prompt adherence and abstract design principles, as well as numerically for geometric design principles. These three evaluations are combined into a single fitness score, and unique high-fitness layouts are stored in an archive. Finally, the highest-fitness layouts are selected.
blocks.zh: 我们针对编辑场景的程序(图2),将重排为进化搜索。 场景设计器3 D通过重复家长选择,突变和评价步骤来演化这类程序的人群. 在每次迭代中,SceneDesigner3D从一组固定的策略中选择一个母体进行突变和突变策略,并通过代理会话产生新的候选布局. 然后用一个VLM来评价布局,以便迅速坚持和抽象设计原则,并且用数字来评价几何设计原则. 这三项评价合并为一个健身评分,独特的高档布局被存于档案馆. 最后,选择了最适合的布局.

blocks.en: 3.1 Scene and Program Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 场景和方案代表性

blocks.en:
The rearrangement is represented as a single Python function rearrange(scene, prompt) that operates on the input scene S S . The rearrange function queries and edits the scene through a fixed scene API, which allows it to query the current scene geometrically for object sizes, their front directions and distances to walls, and edit the scene through functions such as move and put_on . The API also contains other functions for finding free spots and grouping objects together. Only the rearrange function is evolved.
In addition to the input object arrangement, the program has access to object cards : a fixed set of useful descriptors of each object including appearance, material and functionality, extracted by a VLM from multiview renders of the objects.
blocks.zh:
重排表示为单 Python 函数重排(scene, poil),在输入场景 S 上运行. 重排函数查询和编辑场景通过固定场景 API,允许它通过移动和设置等功能对当前场景进行几何查询,以了解物体大小,其前向和距离到墙壁,编辑场景. API还包含其他功能,用于查找自由点和将对象组合在一起. 只有重排函数被演化.
除了输入对象安排外,程序还可以访问对象卡 :每个对象的一组固定的有用描述符,包括外观,材料和功能,由一个VLM从对象的多视图成像中提取.

blocks.en: The input prompt is decomposed into a set of fine-grained requirements ℛ = { r j } \mathcal{R}=\{r_{j}\} by an LLM once before the evolution starts. This allows the evaluation step to focus on different parts of the prompt that need to be satisfied in isolation.
blocks.zh: 输入提示符在进化开始前被一个LLM分解成一组细纹要求 R = { r j }\ mathcal{ R}=\{r_{j}\}} 。 这使得评价步骤能够侧重于需要单独满足的提示的不同部分.

blocks.en: 3.2 Population and Parent Selection
blocks.zh: 3.2 人口和父母选择

blocks.en: We initialize the population of candidate layouts using K K design seeds , which are high-level ideas output by an LLM based on the input scene arrangement. The seeds place large objects in different regions of the scene. They only decide different initial directions for the evolution and can be freely updated in future iterations. Evolution is performed in M M different islands. In every future iteration, a parent i i is sampled for mutation using the weighted strategy from ShinkaEvolve [ 13 ] , with a probability proportional to w i = σ ⁡ ( λ ⁡ ( a i − med ⁡ ( a ) ) ) ​ 1 1 + n i , w_{i}=\sigma\!(\lambda(\,a_{i}-\operatorname{med}(a){}))\,\frac{1}{1+n_{i}}, (1) where a i a_{i} is the fitness of program i i , med ⁡ ( a ) \operatorname{med}(a) is the median fitness, σ \sigma is the sigmoid function, n i n_{i} is the number of children of program i i and λ \lambda controls the sharpness of the sigmoid. This weighted score controls the balance between exploitation of high-fitness proposals and exploration of parents with few children.
blocks.zh: 我们通过 K K 设计种子来初始化候选布局的人口, 这些种子是由 LLM 基于输入场景安排的高级创意输出 。 种子将大型物体放置在现场的不同区域. 它们只决定不同的进化初始方向,并且可以在未来的迭代中自由更新. 进化是在MM不同岛屿上进行的。 在每一个未来的迭代中,一个母体i被采样,使用来自ShinkaEvolve [13] 的加权策略进行突变,概率与w i = \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\1\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ (1) i a_{i} 是程序 i 的适切性, med ⁡ (a)\ operatorname{med}(a) 是中位适切性,\ sigma 是 sigmoid 函数, n i n_{i} 是程序 i 和\ lambda 的孩子数量 控制 sigmoid 的锐度. 这一加权分数控制了对高身材建议和对子女少的父母的探索之间的平衡。

blocks.en:
We further balance between exploration and exploitation during the mutation step by selecting from different high-level mutation strategies. First, we refine the chosen parent if it has high fitness and previous refinements increased its fitness, keeping most of its coarse layout and making smaller local edits based on the weakest judged requirements and principles from previous iterations. Second, we choose to explore new rearrangements by picking from a fixed sub-list of options: (1) re-seed the design by generating a new high-level idea (2) make a large change by moving large objects (3) move only objects that have not moved so far (4) move 1–2 large objects to regions they have not occupied so far and rebuild around them (5) attempt to exchange the positions of two large objects (6) cross over the parent program with the inspiration program given as input context. The mutator agent selects one choice, given the number of attempts of each choice and how many times it led to a new best layout or a new archive cell.
The third option is a scheduled redesign of the scene which must re-place a large fraction of the objects in the scene with a sufficient change in the scene-graph, constructed by inferring edges between nearby objects.
blocks.zh:
我们通过从不同的高层次突变策略中选择,在突变阶段进一步平衡勘探和开发. 首先,如果被选中的家长身体健康,而且以前的改进提高了他们的体质,那么我们就对其进行精细化,保持其大部分粗糙的布局,并根据以往重复中最弱的判断要求和原则,使地方编辑工作更小。 其次,我们选择从固定的子选项列表中选择探索新的重排: (1)通过产生新的高层次理念来重播设计 (2) 通过移动大对象来进行大改变 (3) 移动的只是尚未移动至今的物体 (4) 移动1-2个大对象到它们至今尚未占据的区域,并在它们周围重建 (5) 尝试用作为输入背景的启发程序来交换两个大对象的位置 (6) 跨越母程序. 变异剂会选择一个选择,考虑到每个选择的尝试次数,以及它导致新的最佳布局或新的存档单元格的多少次.
第三种选择是按期重新设计场景,必须重新放置场景中相当一部分的物体,并充分改变场景图,由附近物体之间的推导边缘构造.

blocks.en: 3.3 Agentic Mutation
blocks.zh: 3.3 物剂突变

blocks.en:
We send the selected parent layout to a VLM agent, which edits its program to generate a new child layout.
The agent operates in an isolated workspace, where it can create and run Python scripts, read provided input files and write to files. The agent is prompted with several inputs: a detailed description of the rearrangement task, the input scene and generated requirement list, the parent layout and text feedback from the previous evaluation, the current mutation strategy and mode, and an inspiration program sampled over all islands. The feedback describes the current fulfillment of each requirement and design principle and reasons for each rating.
The agent has access to several tools and context files, including the scene API, functions to compute the numerical design principles, renders of the parent layout, a top-down labelled plan indicating object locations in 2D, object cards and renders of objects. It can also access a test tool that executes a candidate layout and reports colliding meshes, computed design principle scores and comparisons to existing layouts. The agent uses these tools and context files through a multi-turn session.
blocks.zh:
我们向一个 VLM 代理发送选中的父版式, 代理编辑其程序以生成新的子版式 。
该代理在孤立的工作空间中运行,可以在此创建和运行Python脚本,读取提供输入文件并写入文件. 该代理商受到一些投入的激励:对重排任务的详细描述,输入场景和生成的要求列表,前一次评价的母版布局和文本反馈,当前突变策略和模式,以及在所有岛屿上取样的启发程序. 反馈描述了目前对每项要求的履行情况以及每项评级的设计原则和理由。
代理机可访问多个工具和上下文文件,包括场景 API,计算数字设计原理的功能,使父版式,一个自上而下标明2D中对象位置的计划,对象卡和对象的制作. 它还可以访问一个测试工具,用以执行候选人的布局和报告碰撞、计算设计原则分数和与现有布局进行比较。 代理通过多回合会话使用这些工具和上下文文件.

blocks.en: 3.4 Evaluation and Fitness
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价和适宜性

blocks.en: The evaluation step checks the validity and quality of the generated scene, finds unsatisfied prompt requirements and design principles using a VLM as well as numerically computed design principles, and packages these as concise feedback to following mutation steps. The prompt adherence and principles scores are combined together into a single fitness score, which is used to sample parents and maintain an archive of high-quality layouts.
blocks.zh: 评估步骤检查生成场景的有效性和质量,发现使用VLM和数字计算设计原则的不满意的即时要求和设计原则,并将这些包作为后续突变步骤的简要反馈。 迅速遵守和原则的分数合并为单一健身分数,用于对父母进行抽样,保持高质量布局的档案.

blocks.en: The first check ensures that objects are within the scene bounds, do not collide or float or block doors and windows. The evaluation is stopped at this stage for invalid and near-duplicate proposals. Valid layouts are then rendered from several fixed viewpoints, which are judged by the VLM in the next steps.
blocks.zh: 第一次检查确保物体在场景界限内,不会碰撞或浮起或挡住门窗. 现阶段停止评价无效和几乎重复的建议。 然后从几个固定角度给出有效的布局,在接下来的步骤中由VLM判断.

Additionally, it outputs an absolute adherence score for the whole prompt s T ∈ [ 0 , 10 ] s_{T}\in[0,10] , as well as short reasoning. This allows fine-grained feedback both in isolation and in relation to the parent.
The preferences are averaged over the requirements, scaled by a fixed factor α \alpha and added to the rating of the parent A A to obtain the rating of the child B B : ρ T ​ ( B ) = ρ T ​ ( A ) + α | ℛ | ​ ∑ r ∈ ℛ q r \rho_{T}(B)=\rho_{T}(A)+\frac{\alpha}{|\mathcal{R}|}\sum_{r\in\mathcal{R}}q_{r} The ratings are initialized at 1 1 for the input scene and updated for each child layout. We incorporate ten abstract design principles that are commonly used in the literature [ 6 , 17 ] , specified as short descriptions with examples: (1) zoning : separate zones for different activities (2) floating and anchoring : object groups may be anchored to a single object or free-standing (3) alignment of objects to the architectural features of the scene (4) balance and proportion of objects (5) emphasis on a single focal point (6) composition : intentional symmetry, asymmetry or a radial arrangement (7) comfort through visibility of the scene and placement of objects (8) harmony and contrast of different object styles (9) functionality of every object being ensured (10) order of objects such that they satisfy a meaningful purpose .
These descriptions are identical to the ones given to the mutation agent for a shared notion of quality. Similar to the prompt adherence evaluation, the VLM evaluates the design principles and outputs preferences q k q_{k} , which update the ratings ρ k \rho_{k} in the same way, and absolute scores s k ∈ [ 0 , 10 ] s_{k}\in[0,10] , along with reasoning. In addition to the VLM evaluation which captures fine-grained semantics and design principles, we measure nine numerical design principles that are geometrically obtained from the generated layouts, each measuring different aspects: (1) circulation : the walkable regions and paths to objects (2) zoning : arrangement of objects in distinct functional zones (3) conversation : arrangement of seating such that they are facing each other and not too far apart (4) focal point : the orientation of seating towards a focal object in the scene such as a television or whiteboard (5) clearance : free space around objects (6) wall alignment : alignment of objects along walls (7) windows : windows not blocked by objects (8) clutter : how free the floor is of small clutter objects (9) visual balance : the spread of objects throughout the scene .

blocks.en: 3.5 Archive of Diverse Layouts
blocks.zh: 3.5 不同布局的归档

blocks.en: Apart from the mutation strategies and design seeds which explore diverse layouts, we maintain a MAP-Elites archive [ 18 ] of distinct structural layouts. The cells of the archive are defined by the coarse location of the largest objects in the scene. A new layout replaces an existing layout in a cell only if it has a higher fitness. Additionally, a layout that opens a new archive cell or improves it receives a small probability bonus of being selected as a parent.
blocks.zh: 除了探索不同布局的突变策略和设计种子外,我们保持了具有不同结构布局的MAP-Elites档案[18]. 存档的单元格由场景中最大物体的粗细位置定义. 新的布局只有在具有更高的健身能力时,才会取代单元格中的现有布局. 此外,如果布局能打开一个新的归档单元格或改进它,则会获得被选为父的微小概率奖金.

blocks.en: 3.6 Application to Rearrangement Planning
blocks.zh: 3.6 重新安排规划的适用

blocks.en: We show an extension of our evolutionary search that continues the existing evolution with an additional move planner evaluation, such that layouts are also steered towards physical feasibility. We execute a fixed move planner that runs during the evaluation step and plans the physical movement from object locations and orientations in the input scene to those in the rearranged layout. Objects are placed on a fine-grained occupancy grid on the floor and moved using a minimum-cost path search over position and orientation (Dijkstra’s algorithm). Several different object orders are attempted, and objects that block the path of other objects are temporarily moved to free space. The mutation agent receives the rearrangement plan of its parent as feedback, including a list of objects that are blocked. The fitness for evolution remains as before. The final planned layouts are chosen based on additional movement scores which measure the difficulty of the move normalized by path distance and number of objects. Layouts with high move plan scores are chosen such that their fitness is within 2 % 2\% of the top fitness candidates. Details are in the supplementary.
blocks.zh: 我们展示了我们进化探索的延伸,通过额外的移动规划员评价,延续了现有的进化,从而将布局引导到物理可行性。 我们执行一个固定的移动规划器,在评估步骤中运行,并规划从输入场景中的物体位置和方向到重排布局中的物理运动. 物体被放置在地板上的精细占用网格上,并使用最低成本的路径搜索在位置和方向上移动(Dijkstra的算法). 尝试了几种不同的物体命令,阻碍其他物体路径的物体被临时移动到自由空间. 变异剂接收其母体的重排计划作为反馈,包括被阻断的对象列表. 进化的适宜性仍然如前。 最终的计划布局是根据额外的运动分数来选择的,这些分数通过路径距离和对象数量来测量运动正常化的难度. 运动计划得分很高的布局被选中,以至于其健身能力在最高健身能力候选人的2%到2 %之内。 详情见补充部分。

blocks.en: We use Claude Opus 5.5 as the mutation and evaluation agent and for generating 4–6 requirements and K = 8 K=8 design seeds. We use Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct [ 3 ] for object cards. We use λ = 10 \lambda=10 and α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 . The top-3 layouts by fitness are selected as the output layouts. We use M = 4 M=4 islands and a budget of $10, which gives on average 35 proposals in 24 minutes.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation setting
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设置

blocks.en: We evaluate SceneDesigner3D and baselines on three datasets: 33 scenes from the original SAGE-10k dataset [ 32 ] , 31 scenes from SAGE-Opus, an improved version of the SAGE dataset generated using Opus 5.5, and 25 scenes from SceneSmith [ 21 ] . Both SAGE and SceneSmith are agentically generated large-scale datasets that include diverse scene types, object layouts and long-tail objects. Scenes are sampled such that the different scene types in each dataset are represented. Input text prompts are either written manually or suggested by Opus 5.5 and edited.
blocks.zh: 我们评价SceneDesigner3D和三个数据集的基线:33幕来自原SAGE-10k数据集[32],31幕来自SAGE-Opus,一个使用Opus 5.5生成的SAGE数据集的改进版,25幕来自SceneSmith [21]. SAGE和SceneSmith都是代理生成的大型数据集,包括不同的场景类型,对象布局和长尾对象. 对场景进行取样,以显示每个数据集中的不同场景类型。 输入文本提示要么手动写成,要么由Opus 5.5提出并编辑.

blocks.en: 4.2 Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 计量

blocks.en: We evaluate generated layouts for adherence to the input prompt (Prompt Adherence/PA) and design principles (Design Principles/DP). Since this evaluation requires understanding of complex semantics and spatial reasoning, we use two held-out VLMs which are not used during evolution or in the baselines: Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct [ 3 ] and Gemma 4 31B Instruct [ 27 ] . These VLMs are given the generated layouts, and additionally the input text prompt for PA, and prompted for 0–10 scores. We report the mean of the scores output from these two VLMs. We also report the mean of measurable principles which are optimized by our method as Computed Principles (0–1, CP) and selected individual metrics: circulation (walkability), focal (orientation towards focal object) and clutter (absence of small clutter objects on the floor).

4.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线

blocks.en: We compare against 6 state-of-the-art baselines. LayoutGPT [ 9 ] generates scenes as stylesheets, LayoutVLM [ 25 ] generates scenes as code with optimizable constraints and ScanEdit [ 8 ] uses an LLM agent for problem decomposition followed by constraint optimization. Edit-As-Act [ 19 ] performs rearrangement by planning the end goal as a set of predicates, and working backwards from the goal to output a minimal sequence of edits. SceneAssistant [ 16 ] uses an agentic VLM refinement loop to optimize for physical correctness. LayoutGPT, LayoutVLM and SceneAssistant are adapted to the rearrangement task by conditioning on the input object positions and renders of the scene, while ScanEdit and Edit-As-Act are designed for scene editing. Additionally, we compare against a fully agentic Opus 5.5 baseline Opus-Agent which is given the same input scene and text prompt as ours along with detailed instructions of the rearrangement task and the design principles to be followed. In all cases, we use Opus 5.5 as the LLM/VLM for fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了6个最新基线。 布局GPT [9] 生成场景作为样式表,布局VLM [25] 生成场景作为有可选择约束的代码,ScanEdit [8] 使用LLM代理进行问题解析,然后进行约束优化. Edit-As-Act [19]通过将最终目标规划为一组上游目标来进行重排,从目标向后工作,输出最小的编辑序列. 场景助理 [16] 使用代理 VLM 精细循环来优化物理正确性. 布局GPT,布局VLM和场景助理都通过在输入对象位置上设置条件和使场景成形来适应重排任务,而ScanEdit和Edit-As-Act则设计用于场景编辑. 此外,我们与一个完全具有特效的Opus 5.5基线Opus-Agent进行比较,它得到与我们相同的输入场景和文本提示,同时详细指示重排任务和应遵循的设计原则。 在所有情况下,我们使用Opus 5.5作为LLM/VLM进行公平比较.

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparison to State of the Art
blocks.zh: 4.4 与艺术状况的比较

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Qualitative comparison of SceneDesigner3D against baselines on the SAGE, SAGE-Opus and SceneSmith datasets. The input scenes and text prompts are shown on the top. SceneDesigner3D generates rearrangements that strongly satisfy the input prompt as well as common interior design principles such as reachability of objects, functional zoning and visual balance.
blocks.zh: 图3:场景设计师的质量比较3 D对照SAGE、SAGE-OPUS和SceneSmith数据集上的基线。 输入场景和文本提示显示在顶部. 场景设计器3 D生成强烈满足输入速率的重排以及常见的室内设计原理,如物体的可达性,功能分区和视觉平衡.

blocks.en: Quantitative results on SAGE, SAGE-Opus and SceneSmith datasets are shown in Tab. 1 . On SAGE, SceneDesigner3D outperforms baselines by 5.1% on Prompt Adherence, 2.1% on VLM Design Principles and 15.2% on the Computed Principles score. It similarly outperforms baselines on both SAGE-Opus and SceneSmith. Baselines often generate small localized edits, and do not redesign the scene. ScanEdit and SceneAssistant tend to move only objects mentioned in the prompt, while LayoutGPT and LayoutVLM perform larger changes, but make limited use of global scene semantics and hence produce scenes with poorer functionality and aesthetics. Opus-Agent has a stronger prior for design principles and generates plausible scenes, but remains closer to the input scenes. In contrast, SceneDesigner3D leverages fine-grained object semantic and visual information, detailed feedback from a VLM as well as computed principle scores and optimizes for these by proposing a diverse set of solutions. This is also observed through the scene graph diversity score, where SceneDesigner3D outputs semantically diverse scenes.
blocks.zh: SAGE,SAGE-OPUS和SceneSmith数据集的定量结果在Tab中显示. 1,在SAGE上,场景设计师3D在快速遵守时比基线高出5.1%,在VLM设计原则上高出2.1%,在计算的原则分数上高出15.2%。 同样,它在SAGE-OPUS和SceneSmith上的表现都超过了基线。 基线经常产生小的局部编辑,而不重新设计场景. ScanEdit和Scene Abel往往只移动提示中提及的对象,而布局GPT和布局VLM则进行更大的改变,但对全球场景语义的使用有限,从而产生功能和美学较差的场景. Opus-Agent在设计原理上有着更强的前置功能,并产生可信的场景,但依然更接近输入场景. 相比之下,SceneDesigner3D则利用精细的物体语义和视觉信息,从VLM中的详细反馈以及计算原理分数,并通过提出一套多样的解决方案来优化这些. 这也通过场景图多样性得分来观测,其中SceneDesigner3D输出出各种场景.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Quantitative comparison on the SAGE, SAGE-Opus, and SceneSmith datasets. PA: prompt adherence (VLM judges, 0–10); DP: design principles (VLM judges, 0–10); CP: computed design principles (mean); Div: Scene-graph diversity. The best results per dataset are bolded and the second best are underlined .
blocks.zh: 表1:SAGE、SAGE-OPUS和SceneSmith数据集的定量比较。 PA:即时遵守(VLM法官,0–10);DP:设计原理(VLM法官,0–10);CP:计算设计原理(平均);Div:场景图多样性. 每个数据集的最佳结果都是大胆的,其次是下划线。

blocks.en: A qualitative comparison of the rearranged scenes with the corresponding text prompts is shown in Fig. 3 . SceneDesigner3D rearranges objects in a balanced manner across the available space, separates objects into functional zones, and ensures symmetry of arrangement while maintaining strong adherence to the input prompt.
blocks.zh: 图3显示重排场景与相应文字提示的定性比较。 场景设计器3 D以平衡的方式对物体进行跨现有空间的重排,将物体分割成功能区,并确保安排的对称性,同时保持对输入提示的强烈遵守.

blocks.en: We conducted a perceptual study with 15 participants to compare our generated rearrangements against baselines. Participants are first shown 18 pairs of scenes from SceneDesigner3D and baselines, and choose the one with higher prompt adherence and design principles. Next, they rate 21 layouts across all methods on a 1–5 scale for the same two metrics. Results are shown in Tab. 2 . SceneDesigner3D is preferred over all baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一项有15名参与者参与的感知研究,将我们产生的重新安排与基线进行比较。 参与者首先从SceneDesigner3D和基线显示18对场景,并选择具有较高快速遵守和设计原则的场景. 其次,它们对所有方法的21种布局进行1比5的评分,对相同的两个度量衡进行评分. 结果见Tab。 2,场景设计师3D优于所有基线.

blocks.en: Table 2 : User study on the SAGE, SAGE-Opus, and SceneSmith datasets. Left: share (%) of pairwise choices preferring SceneDesigner3D over each baseline. Right: mean rating (1–5) of each method. PA: prompt adherence, DP: design principles.
blocks.zh: 表2:关于SAGE,SAGE-Opus和SceneSmith数据集的用户研究. 左侧: 双向选择的% 偏好 SceneDesigner3D 而不是每个基线 。 对:每种方法的平均评分(1-5). PA:迅速遵守,DP:设计原则.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate the different components of our method on a subset of 15 SAGE scenes to show their contribution to the full method. Results are shown in Tab. 3 . Each component is shown to contribute to the final score either in terms of diversity, prompt adherence or design principles.
blocks.zh: 在15个SAGE场景的子集上,我们放弃了我们方法的不同组成部分,以显示他们对全方法的贡献. 结果见Tab。 3. 每个组成部分都显示在多样性、迅速遵守或设计原则方面对最后得分作出贡献。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Ablation study of the different components of our method on a subset of 15 SAGE scenes. Each component is ablated independently from the full model.
blocks.zh: 表3:在15个SAGE场景的子集上,对我们方法的不同成分进行对比研究. 每一个组件都独立于完整的模型。

blocks.en: SceneDesigner3D generates an evolutionary tree of proposals based on fitness scores. Tab. 3 shows that replacing this with one-shot generation of multiple designs leads to lower diversity and aggregate metrics. This is because structurally different layouts are not explored and proposals are not iteratively improved through feedback.
blocks.zh: 场景设计器3 D根据健身成绩生成一棵渐进式的推荐树. 标签3显示,用一发多发的设计取代这一设计会导致多样性和汇总度量较低。 这是因为没有探索结构上不同的布局,也没有通过反馈反复改进建议.

blocks.en: We compare our full method with a variant without the MAP-Elites archive, and with a variant that removes both the population and the archive and instead performs a linear greedy search, always mutating the current best layout, in Tab. 3 . Both variants keep our diversity mechanisms in the mutation step (design seeds, exploration strategies and redesigns) and the full evaluation step. These mechanisms preserve diversity, but both variants reduce the quality of the rearrangements in terms of prompt adherence and design principles, whereas our full model achieves both the highest diversity and the highest overall quality.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个没有 MAP-Elites 存档的变体来比较我们的全部方法, 和一个既去掉人口又去掉档案的变体, 进行线性贪婪的搜索, 总是在Tab中改变当前最好的布局。 3. 两种变体都把我们的多样性机制保留在变异步骤(设计种子、勘探战略和重新设计)和全面评价步骤中。 这些机制保持了多样性,但两个变体在迅速遵守和设计原则方面都降低了重新安排的质量,而我们的全面模式既实现了最高的多样性,也实现了最高的整体质量。

blocks.en: We use only the local exploration strategy by removing the refinement and redesign strategies from the mutation and compare in Tab. 3 . This leads to a significantly reduced diversity score of 0.64 0.64 compared to 0.80 0.80 with our full model, and shows that the combination of our multiple diversity strategies leads to better exploration of the design space.
blocks.zh: 我们只采用当地勘探战略,从突变中去除完善和重新设计战略,并在Tab中进行比较。 3,这导致多样性分数大幅降低,为0.64 0.64分,而我们全模式为0.80 0.80分,并表明我们多种多样性战略的结合,可以更好地探索设计空间.

blocks.en: We use an agentic mutator that refines a rearrangement proposal in multiple turns before evaluation. We compare this with a single VLM turn mutation in Tab. 3 . Using a single turn reduces all the aggregate scores. Our agentic refinement step allows each mutation to fully incorporate VLM feedback and satisfy design principles.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一种介质变异器,在评价前多次修改重排提案。 我们把这和Tab的一个VLM转弯突变作比较。 3,采用单转法减少所有总分. 我们的代理完善步骤使每个突变都能够充分纳入VLM反馈并满足设计原则.

blocks.en: We remove the abstract design principles and the corresponding VLM evaluation during evolution and compare in Tab. 3 . This reduces both PA and DP scores, while our full model uses these principles to generate functional, balanced scenes with aesthetic composition.
blocks.zh: 我们在进化过程中删除抽象设计原理和相应的VLM评价,并在Tab中进行比较. 3,这降低了PA和DP的分数,而我们的完整模型则利用这些原则产生功能平衡的场景,具有美学成分.

blocks.en: We remove the computed design principles in the feedback during evolution and compare in Tab. 3 . This causes the largest reduction in CP, while SceneDesigner3D uses this feedback to evolve walkable, focused and uncluttered rearrangements among other aspects.
blocks.zh: 我们删除进化过程中反馈中的计算设计原理,并在 Tab 中进行比较。 3,这导致CP减少量最大,而SceneDesigner3D则利用这种反馈在其他方面进化出可行走,有重点且不杂乱的重排.

blocks.en: 4.6 Application to Rearrangement Planning
blocks.zh: 4.6 重新安排规划的适用

blocks.en: We evaluate the application of SceneDesigner3D to planning a feasible rearrangement and compare against Opus-Agent given the same feedback from the move planner. The planner tool runs on final layouts of each method to obtain rearrangement plans. We evaluate three metrics: (i) blocked , the fraction of the moved objects that cannot reach their goal; (ii) extra distance , the excess distance that objects must be carried, divided by total straight-line distance; and (iii) walk overhead , the empty-handed walking distance, divided by carried distance. Results are shown in Tab. 4 . SceneDesigner3D evolves rearrangements with improved feasibility that can be implemented efficiently.
blocks.zh: 我们评价SceneDesigner3D在规划可行的重排时的应用,并与Opus-Agent进行比较,因为移动规划师的反馈相同. 规划员工具运行在每种方法的最终布局上,以获得重新安排计划. 我们评价三个衡量标准:(一) 阻塞,移动物体中无法达到目标的部分;(二) 额外距离,物体必须携带的超距离,除以总直线距离;和(三) 行走高度,空手行走距离,除以载走距离. 结果见Tab。 4. 场地设计师3 D随着可行性的提高而进行重新安排,从而可以有效地实施。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Rearrangement planning metrics on 33 scenes from the SAGE dataset. SceneDesigner3D produces more feasible rearrangements.
blocks.zh: 表4:来自SAGE数据集的33个场景的重排规划指标. 场景设计器3 D产生更可行的重新安排。

blocks.en: While our method generates high-quality scenes respecting functionality and aesthetics, it leverages VLM feedback, which may be unreliable on very small objects. Our method operates on indoor scenes containing rigid objects and does not consider potential articulations or deformations of objects.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的方法生成了尊重功能和美学的高质量场景,但它利用了VLM反馈,这在非常小的物体上可能是不可靠的. 我们的方法在室内的场景中运作,包含刚性物体,不考虑物体的潜在表达或变形.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented SceneDesigner3D, an agentic evolutionary search method for 3D scene rearrangement. We showed that VLM mutation and evaluation produce diverse, functional and aesthetic rearrangements, and hope this will encourage future work on evolutionary methods for 3D generation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了SceneDesigner3D,一种3D场景重排的代理演化搜索方法. 我们显示,VLM突变和评价产生了多样的,功能的和美学的重排,希望这将鼓励今后为3D生成而进行进化方法的工作.

We see that both VLMs have the same trends across all three datasets and both prompt adherence and design principles. Differences in the absolute scores are expected since the VLMs are trained on different data distributions. SceneDesigner3D largely matches or outperforms baselines when evaluated by either VLM independently.
blocks.zh: 我们比较两名被搁置的VLM评委的分数: Qwen3-VL-32B-Instructionct和Gemma 4 31B 在Fig. 4中的Instruction. 我们看到,在所有三个数据集中,两个甚高频都具有相同的趋势,以及迅速遵守和设计原则。 由于对VLM进行不同数据分布的培训,预计绝对分数会有差异. 场景设计器3 D在由VLM独立评估时基本匹配或超过基线。

blocks.en: We also report the Kendall’s τ \tau , which measures how similarly the two VLMs rank the seven methods. τ \tau ranges from − 1 -1 (inverse ordering) to 1 1 (identical ordering). τ > 0.7 \tau>0.7 is generally considered to show strong agreement. blocks.en: 7 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 7 执行细节

blocks.en: 7.1 Evolution
blocks.zh: 7.1 演变

blocks.en:
The evolved program is a single rearrange function that takes the input scene and text prompt as input, and returns the rearranged object locations and orientations. It has access to an API with useful functions such as move , free_spot , place_near and push_against_wall .
We use a modified version of ShinkaEvolve [ 13 ] , and perform full rewrites of the rearrangement program. We sample inspiration programs across all islands.
blocks.zh:
演化后的程序是一个单一的重排函数,它以输入场景和文本提示作为输入,并返回重排的对象位置和方向. 它拥有访问 API 的功能, 如移动、 自由点、 位置附近和 推动_ 反对_ 墙 。
我们使用ShinkaEvolve [13] 的修改版,并完成重排程序的全部重写. 我们对所有岛屿的启发计划进行抽样。

blocks.en: The evolution starts with a single LLM call that outputs K = 8 K=8 short design ideas, which are then used for the first K K mutations.
blocks.zh: 演化开始于单LLM调用输出K=8K=8短设计理念,然后用于第一次KK突变.

blocks.en: 7.2 MAP-Elites Archive
blocks.zh: 7.2 MAP-Elites 存档

blocks.en: Cells in the archive are created according to the floor quadrant occupied by each anchor object. Anchor objects are the two largest movable objects on the floor, followed by any large objects that are mentioned in the prompt ( ≥ 0.4 \geq 0.4\, m 2 ) and other large objects ( ≥ 0.6 \geq 0.6\, m 2 ). When a new layout opens a new archive cell, it receives a fitness bonus of 0.03 0.03 for parent sampling. If a layout improves an existing cell, it receives a bonus of 0.01 0.01 .
blocks.zh: 归档中的单元格是根据每个锚对象占用的地板四象限创建的. 锚心物体是地板上两个最大的可移动物体,后面是提示(≥ 0.4\geq 0.4\, m 2 )和其他大物体(≥ 0.6\geq 0.6\, m 2 )中提到的任何大物体. 当一个新的布局打开一个新的归档细胞时,它会得到0.03 0.03的健身奖金,用于父母取样. 如果一个布局改进了现有的单元格,则得到0.01 0.01的奖金。

blocks.en: The mutation mode is selected based on the current state of the evolution and the selected parent, from among three options: exploration (with several sub-options), refinement (of existing candidates) and redesign (large changes from scratch).
blocks.zh: 变异模式是根据进化现状和被选中的母体选择的,从三个选项中选择:探索(有多个子选项),完善(现有候选者)和重新设计(从零开始的巨大变化).

blocks.en: Refinement involves smaller changes to an existing high-quality layout. When the parent is one of the best three layouts by fitness, it is refined.
blocks.zh: 完善涉及对现有高质量布局的较小改动. 当父母通过健身成为最佳的三种布局之一时,会加以完善.

blocks.en: Redesigns are scheduled at fixed exponentially increasing intervals (1st, 3rd and 7th evaluation after the seed phase ( 2 j − 1 2^{j}-1 )), and each followed by a fixed number of refinements. A redesign mutation ignores the input object positions and earlier layouts, and follows the least-used design seed to arrange objects freely. It must move at least 70% of the movable floor objects. Redesign-refinements must preserve the new structure of the redesign.
blocks.zh: 重新设计按固定指数递增的间隔进行(种子阶段后第1次、第3次和第7次评价(2 j − 1 2 ^{j → 1 )),然后每一次进行固定的改进。 重新设计的突变忽略了输入对象的位置和早期的布局,遵循最少使用的设计种子来自由安排对象. 它必须至少移动70%的可移动地板物体. 重新设计必须保留重新设计的新结构。

blocks.en: For every other selection of parent, the mutator explores new designs. It has a fixed set of exploration strategies and can access statistics on how often each strategy has been tried and how often it produced a new best layout or a new archive cell. If a strategy failed twice on the same parent, it cannot be selected in future mutations.
blocks.zh: 对于父母的所有其他选择,变异者探索新的设计. 它有一套固定的勘探战略,并且可以获取关于每项战略试验次数和产生新的最佳布局或新的档案单元的频率的统计数据。 如果策略在同一个父上两次失败,则在未来的突变中无法选择.

blocks.en: Mutation is performed by the Claude Opus 5.5 VLM with file and shell tools in a sandboxed environment. Each mode has different reasoning and turn budgets: (1) seed: low effort, 12 turns (2) exploration and refinement: low effort, no thinking, 8 turns (3) redesign: medium effort, thinking, 10 turns (4) redesign-refinement: medium effort, thinking, 8 turns.
blocks.zh: 突变由克劳德·奥普斯5.5 VLM在沙盒环境中用文件和贝壳工具进行. 每种模式都有不同的推理和转动预算:(1)种子:低努力,12转(2) 探索和精炼:低努力,无思考,8转(3) 重新设计:中努力,思考,10转(4) 重新设计-精炼:中努力,思考,8转.

blocks.en: 7.3 Validity Check
blocks.zh: 7.3 有效性检查

blocks.en:
A rearrangement is invalid if: (1) it moves a fixed object (2) it moves an object outside the scene bounds (3) it causes two object bounding boxes to overlap by more than 0.006 ​ m 3 0.006m^{3} beyond their overlap in the input, or their mesh overlap (1 cm voxels) grows by more than 0.0005 ​ m 3 0.0005m^{3} (4) the center of a supported object leaves the support (5) it places an object taller than 0.25 0.25\, m in front of a door (6) it places an object taller than 1.3 1.3\, m within 0.4 0.4\, m of a window (7) it disconnects doors that were originally connected in the input .
Objects on top of other objects move along with the supporting object. Invalid layouts do not proceed to the evaluation step, instead they receive a low fitness score.
blocks.zh:
重排无效,如果:(1) 它移动一个固定物体(2) 它将一个物体移动到场景界限以外(3) 它导致两个对象的边框重叠超过0.006 m 3 0.006 m\\\ 3}超过它们在输入中的重叠,或者它们的网格重叠(1 cm voxels) 增长超过 0.0005 m 3 0.0005 m\ 3} (4)被支持对象的中心离开支持 (5) 它将一个高于0.25 0.25\,米的物体放置在门前 (6) 它将一个高于1.3\,米在0.4 0.4\,米在窗口 (7),它断开原来在输入中连接的门......
其他对象之上的物体随辅助对象一起移动。 无效的布局不进入评价步骤,而是获得较低的健身分数.

blocks.en: 7.4 Abstract Design Principles
blocks.zh: 7.4 抽象设计原则

blocks.en: We use ten common abstract design principles, which are given as context to the VLM mutation and evaluation (judge) agents.
blocks.zh: 我们使用十项共同的抽象设计原则,这些原则作为VLM突变和评价(法官)代理人的背景。

blocks.en: • Zoning : furniture must be grouped into zones such as seating, dining, work, sleep, reading, and separated by walking paths between them. Each zone should preferably have its own lighting. • Floating and anchoring : seating and furniture must not always be lined against the walls, they should occupy central positions in the room, preferably anchored by a rug on the floor. • Architecture : the largest or dominant piece of furniture such as a sofa or bed must be aligned with the room’s strongest architectural feature, such as a large window, wall or fireplace. Furniture is placed parallel or perpendicular to walls and to other furniture. • Balance and proportion : visual weight (large/small furniture) must be distributed evenly across the scene. In a single-purpose room, the main furniture must use about two-thirds of the space, so that it is not overcrowded and does not leave large spaces unused. • Emphasis : a room must preferably have one clear focal point, such as a TV against a wall, a large window, whiteboard or fireplace. The main seating can be oriented towards it symmetrically. • Composition : objects must be arranged through deliberate symmetry, radially or asymmetrically. Objects can be repeated at regular intervals through spacing or orientation. • Comfort : the main seating, beds and desks can be placed along walls such that they have a view of the room and window or door diagonally. • Harmony and contrast : objects with matching or complementary styles are grouped and placed together, contrast can be used sparingly and deliberately. • Function : the room must have clear walking paths (main paths ≥ 91 \geq 91\, cm, secondary ≥ 76 \geq 76\, cm), space around objects ( e.g . 76 76\, cm in front of seats, 61 61\, cm in front of cabinets, 91 91\, cm around a dining table), usable distances between related objects ( e.g . coffee table 35–45 cm in front of a sofa, seats for conversation must be 1.2–2.4 m apart). Doors must not be blocked. • Order : every object must be deliberately placed with a reason. Small objects must be gathered onto surfaces and not be left on the floor unless required.
blocks.zh: • 区划:家具必须组合成座椅、餐饮、工作、睡眠、阅读等区,并用它们之间的步行道分隔。 每个区最好有自己的照明。 • 支助 漂浮和锚定:座位和家具不能总是靠墙排成线,它们应该在房间里占据中心位置,最好是用地板上的地毯作为锚。 • 建筑:最大的或占支配地位的家具,如沙发或床,必须与房间最坚固的建筑特征,如大窗、墙壁或壁炉相配合。 家具与墙壁和其他家具平行或垂直。 • 支助 平衡和比例:视觉重量(大/小家具)必须在全场均匀分布。 在单功能室内,主家具必须使用约三分之二的空间,这样不会过度拥挤,也不会留下大面积的空间未使用. • 强调:一个房间最好有一个清晰的焦点,如对墙的电视、大窗、白板或壁炉。 主座可以朝向对称. • 组成:物体必须通过故意对称、射线或不对称的方式排列。 物体可以通过间隔或方向定期重复. • 支助 舒适:主座椅,床位和桌位可以沿墙壁布置,使其能对房间和窗户或门进行对角的透视. • 支助 和谐与对比:具有匹配或互补风格的物体被组合在一起,可以节制和故意使用对比. • 功能:房间必须有清晰的步行道路(主要道路为91\geq 91\,厘米,二级道路为76\geq 76\,厘米),物体周围的空间(如7676\,座位前面的厘米,61\,柜前的厘米,9191\,餐桌周围的厘米),相关物体之间的可用距离(如咖啡桌35-45厘米,谈话座位必须相隔1.2-2.4米)。 门不得堵. • 秩序:每个物体都必须有正当理由。 小型物体必须收集到表面,除非需要,否则不得留在地板上。

blocks.en: The geometrically computed principles give numerical scores independent of the VLMs and are used as feedback as well as in final evaluation. The scores are in the range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and the mean is taken over all scores that apply to a scene.

blocks.en: 7.6 VLM Evaluation and Fitness
blocks.zh: 7.6 VLM (英语). 评价和适宜性

blocks.en: We use Claude Opus 5.5 as the VLM judge for candidate layouts to evaluate prompt adherence and design principles. It is called without any tools. It receives two 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 renders each of the parent and new candidate from two fixed viewpoints, as well as a labeled top-down plan showing object bounding boxes and a list of object positions. It outputs relative preference and absolute scores for the prompt requirements and the design principles, along with short reasoning which forms the feedback to the next mutations.
blocks.zh: 我们利用克劳德·奥普斯·5.5作为候选人排版的VLM评委,评价迅速遵守和设计原则. 它被称为没有任何工具。 它收到两个1280×720 1280\times 720使每个母体和新候选人从两个固定角度出发,以及一个标有标签的上下计划,显示对象的边框和对象位置列表. 它为即时要求和设计原则提供相对偏好和绝对分数,同时提供对下一个变异的反馈的简短推理。

blocks.en: We use two held-out VLM judges (Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct and Gemma 4 31B Instruct) which receive top-down renders of the input and output layouts, two oblique views of the output, close-ups of up to four large moved objects and the labeled plan. Scores are averaged over the two judges and across all evaluated scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个被搁置的VLM评委(Qune3-VL-32B-Instruct和Gemma 4 31B Instruct),这些评委接收自上而下的输入和输出布局,输出的两个斜视图,最多四个大移动对象的特写和标注计划. 评分平均为两名评委和所有评价场景。

blocks.en: 7.7 Rearrangement Planning
blocks.zh: 7.7 重新安排规划

blocks.en: We resume each evolution run with an additional budget of $5. A fixed move planner is run on every valid mutation output (candidate layout) during evaluation. The list of blocked objects, object parking moves and detours is added to the feedback so that the next mutation can resolve them.
blocks.zh: 我们以5美元的额外预算恢复每次演变。 在评价期间,每个有效的变异输出(candidate布局)都会运行一个固定的移动规划器. 在反馈中添加了被屏蔽的对象,对象停车动作和绕行的列表,以便下一次突变可以解析.

blocks.en: Small supported items such as books on a table are moved along with the supporting item. The order of moving objects is chosen by attempting several move heuristic orders (largest object first, nearest object next, object dependency order). The movement is planned using a 5 5 cm grid and 15 ∘ 15^{\circ} orientation bins. Finally, we select the plan with the highest move score among the layouts within 2 % 2\% of the best fitness.
blocks.zh: 表中的书籍等小型辅助项目与辅助项目一起移动。 移动对象的顺序是通过尝试数个移动heuristic命令(最大对象先,最接近对象后,对象依赖命令)来选择的. 运动计划使用一个5 5 cm的网格和15 ∘ 15 ^{\circ]定向箱. 最后,我们选择在布局中动作分数最高的计划 在最佳健身的2% 2 分之内。

blocks.en:
The move plan is evaluated based on the difficulty of the move, normalized by the number of objects moved and the path distance. This allows methods to perform larger rearrangements and achieve diversity without being penalized for it. The computed scores during evolution are: (1) detour : the ratio of moved path length ℓ \ell to the straight-line distance d d (2) hardest move : the largest ratio ℓ / d \ell/d (3) re-handling : the number of handling moves (moving it to its goal or to a temporary spot) per object (4) dependency : the share of rearranged objects that cannot move straight to their goal in the input scene (5) walk overhead : ratio of empty-handed walking distance between moves to the carried path length .
Each score is normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] using the 10th and 90th percentile over all layouts, such that 1 is the best score. The move score is their mean divided by 1 + n b 1+n_{b} , where n b n_{b} is the number of blocked objects.
blocks.zh:
移动计划根据移动的难度来评价,通过移动对象的数量和路径距离来恢复正常. 这使得可以进行更大的重新安排和实现多样性而不受惩罚的方法。 进化过程中计算出的分数为:(1)绕行:移动路径长度l\ell与直线距离d(2) 移动最困难:最大比例l/d\ell/d(3) 重处理:每个物体的处理移动次数(移动到目标或临时位置)(4) 依赖性:无法直接移动到输入场景中目标的重排对象的比例 (5) 行走高度:移动到带载路径长度之间的空手行走距离的比例.
每个得分均使用10和90百分位数在所有布局上正常化为[0,1][0,1],因此1是最佳得分. 移动分数是他们的平均值除以 1 + n b 1+ n_{b},其中 n b n_{b}是被封禁对象的数量.
